# Inputs of the Web daily release build (read by .github/daily-build/daily_gate.py
# --platform web from the commit being considered). A build is due only when the
# fingerprint of the selected files (path, mode, blob id) differs from the one recorded
# in the last web build that was compiled AND published.
#   "+ glob" includes, "- glob" excludes, the last matching rule wins and
#   unmatched files are not inputs. "*" stays in one path segment, "**" crosses.
# Changing the rules changes the fingerprint (one rebuild). Comments do not.
#
# Monorepo layout: apps/client/lib, pubspec.*, l10n.yaml and packages/ are shared by
# every client platform; each platform runner (apps/client/<runner>/) and engine
# recipe belongs only to the platform(s) that build it, so a change there rebuilds
# only those platforms. Keep tests/test_inputs.py in sync when moving files.
version 1

# Product source, shared app config, lockfile, l10n config, this platform's runner
+ apps/client/**
- apps/client/test/**
- apps/client/integration/**
- apps/client/tool/**
- apps/client/analysis_options.yaml
# Other platforms' runners (built by their own daily workflow)
- apps/client/android/**
- apps/client/ios/**
- apps/client/linux/**
- apps/client/macos/**
- apps/client/windows/**
# No native RDP engine in the Web build
- apps/client/native/**

# Local dependency forks (dependency_overrides)
+ packages/**
- packages/*/test/**
- packages/*/example/**
- packages/*/doc/**
- packages/*/analysis_options.yaml
- packages/*/dart_test.yaml
- packages/*/dartdoc_options.yaml

# Documentation never changes a build (no .md file is a bundled asset)
- **/*.md

# Build recipe: pinned SDK installers, this platform's daily workflow and build/packaging
# scripts. The gate/publish scripts, tests and README in .github/daily-build/ are not inputs.
+ tools/install_flutter_linux.sh
+ .github/workflows/daily-web.yml
+ .github/daily-build/recipe/web_*
+ .github/daily-build/recipe/flutter_sdk.py

# Deployment nginx config shipped in the static bundle
+ deploy/nginx.conf
